title: Airbnb prices and calendars
description: Row types in one dataset: listing (price for the dates, rating, location, optional details), calendar (day-by-day availability with an occupancy summary), review, status (per place or listing; never charged).

dataset.title: Airbnb prices and calendars
dataset.description: Listing rows with prices, day-by-day calendar rows, review rows and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
